name: nf_publications_search_config
description: Search configuration for the nf-publications SearchIndex, syn75081631. Default analyzer is the built-in STANDARD (tokenize + lowercase, no stemming); per-column overrides (org.synapse.nf-nf_publications_columns) route id fields to IDENTIFIER, discovery free-text (title, diseaseFocus, manifestation) to the nf_scientific_synonyms analyzer, and clean categorical/facet fields to KEYWORD. Bind only to syn75081631.
